summary: Redesign Settings and reduce repeat workspace reads with scoped browser caching.

api.reason: Settings and cache use existing HTTP operations. API and MCP guidance documents projections and bounded request patterns.
api.permissions: Existing browser membership, policy, Admin settings and PAT authorization stay authoritative on server requests.

metrics.reason: Retain existing request signals and allowlists for network calls. In-memory hits generate no backend request or artificial signal.

businessEvents.reason: Existing settings write and audit pipeline remains authoritative. Navigation and cache hits are presentation and reuse only.

deploymentEvents.reason: Retain exact release metadata and current transport receipts for deployment and CI reporting.

manualVerification: Verify synthetic Settings search, Admin/member deep links, field order and header draft persistence, phone to wide desktop and short or zoomed layouts. Verify cache expiry, invalidation and scoped misses. Compare the custom host release identity after deployment. Actual Firestore usage is a separate measurement.
